items.rationale: The monument owner explicitly supports the 1926–1928 construction, memorial purpose, selected 2,291 m southeast peak and total 39.3 m including the base. I checked the counterexample in the same source: the 2,325 m main summit was rejected, so the proposed wording must not be paraphrased as the main summit. It correctly drops the old saddle and ambiguous 28 m claims.

The museum history supports Bucharest, the open-air format, Gusti’s organising role, May 1936 opening and transferred houses, annexes, churches and installations. It distinguishes building counts from household complexes, which refutes the earlier hundreds-of-households wording. The replacement makes no inflated count or sole-founder claim.

The institution confirms the building inauguration in 1888, its Philharmonic seat and hosting of Enescu festival events. I checked the 1889 concert-hall completion counterexample: the proposed text explicitly refers to the building, not a hall inaugurated in 1888. The principal-stage claim is removed rather than replaced with another unsupported ranking.

The IHF June 2025 first-person career retrospective establishes that Neagu played women’s handball and had finished her official playing career. Historical a jucat is true without asserting current active employment. The sport identity remains intact.

The EHF team page explicitly places Neagu’s national-team farewell after the 2023 World Championship. The IHF retrospective independently describes Romania appearances. Past-tense national participation is supported; it does not confuse national retirement with the later club career end.

The IHF retrospective describes club play for Oltchim and Buducnost and the end of her official career. A separate EHF post-retirement interview with her CSM teammate corroborates retired status. Historical club participation is accurate; no club membership or endpoint is newly invented.

Accept deletion of an unsupported strong casting assertion. I independently checked the licensed CINEPUB film presentation and UCIN film entry plus Dem’s UCIN filmography: they do not establish this casting link and consistently identify other actors. The actor filmography positively supports the B.D. control instead. I do not claim to have watched the full film credits, and absence from a short principal-cast list alone would not prove a universal negative. Under A4, this unverified strong gameplay link should not survive as a generic related_to relabel.
